claims.text: AI systems are not inherently intelligent; their capabilities come from toolkits and example solutions.
Testing AI with modern toolkits like opencode is desired, but older models may struggle due to small context windows.
InstinctGPT compared a ~3B model with GPT-3 175B using external runtime and tools, showing toolkits give large gains but cannot fully compensate for lacking base model abilities.
Modern models aim to extract maximum performance from fewer parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
Some sources charge 650 UAH for diploma covers (from Богдан).
A participant mentioned 30 UAH as a price.
One user suggested that covers are essentially waste paper and could be omitted.
Another comment noted the cover bears the university seal, making it unique.
Someone claimed no one will actually take the cover.
A remark explained the cover will be seen only three times: receiving the diploma, photographing it, and later when translating documents.
The author observed strange people in a bus, describing one who plays piano loudly, then listens to metro announcements, and later makes micro‑sounds before being silenced.
